name: Katarina Lotrič
bio: Katarina is the CEO and co-founder of Gentler Stories, a Slovenian indie studio building health and fitness apps that stem from their own problems. She cares deeply about how an app feels in your hand, and how it treats people using it. Her work across two companies has earned two Apple Design Awards (Lake Coloring, Gentler Streak), two ADA Finalist recognitions, and an App of the Year. She's not a developer — she leads from a human perspective, and that's where the whole "gentler" idea comes from.
